title: erechthites haplogyna

This plant is traditionally used in African medicine, where it is valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Erechthites haplogyna are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat various skin conditions, such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
